# ETFC fiscal 2007 annual report (10-K), page 22

Authoritative, audited figures.

December 18, 2007, we issued an additional 23182197 shares of common stock to citadel. The issuances were exempt from registration pursuant to section 4 (2) of the securities act of 1933, and each purchaser has represented to us that it is an "accredited investor " as defined in regulation d promulgated under the securities act of 1933, and that the common stock was being acquired for investment.
